Onboarding Guide

Skill Manager

An evidence instrument for a multi-agent skill fleet. See which skills each agent can discover, whether installed copies agree, why a runtime sees a skill, and which changes are safe to make. Every skill is a living genome - a five-location strip that stays continuous when copies agree and visibly breaks when they drift.

The Genome Wall - the default landing view. 258 skills, 707 installed copies, drift visible at a glance.

01Why you need it

AI agents are only as good as their skills - but skills rot silently. A fix lands in ~/.agents but not the repo. The same skill name hides two different versions. And nobody can answer "is my skill set up to date?" without spelunking five directories by hand.

Skill Manager makes the inventory visible, the drift detectable, the "what does this actually do" question answerable, and the safe-change decision reviewable - all in one local dashboard.

02Quick start

Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/intelligentrascal/skill-manager.git && cd skill-manager
Install
npm install (zero runtime dependencies - Node built-ins only)
Run
npm run serve
Open
http://127.0.0.1:7788

That is the whole setup. No build step, no config file required - it scans your default skill locations automatically.

03The genome

Skill Manager is built around one idea: a skill is a living genome. Its five locations - pi, opencode, claude, shared, and the repo - either agree (a continuous strip) or have drifted apart (a coral, cracked gene). Health at a glance, no dashboards to decode.

The matrix view - the whole estate as a skill x harness table with status colors.
Full-text search - matches inside SKILL.md bodies with highlighted snippets.
The review queue - every drift and uncommitted-repo skill as an actionable list. It never applies anything on its own.
Watch mode - when a skill copy changes on disk, its strip ripples once, then settles.

04The status model

The core concept. For each skill name, Skill Manager hashes every copy's SKILL.md and compares:

OK DUP DRIFT
StatusMeaningAction
OKOne copy, or multiple identical copiesNothing
DUPMultiple copies, identical content - healthy deployment mirrorsNothing
DRIFTCopies disagree - different content under the same namePick the source of truth, sync the rest

DRIFT is the signal that matters. It means an update landed in one harness but not another, so you are running two different versions of the same skill depending on which agent you ask.

repoClean: for skills in the repo location, Skill Manager also compares the on-disk file against git HEAD - so an uncommitted edit or a stale checkout shows up too.

05What gets scanned

LocationDefault pathLayout
pi~/.pi/agent/skillsflat
opencode~/.config/opencode/skillsflat
claude~/.claude/skillsflat (often symlinks)
shared~/.agents/skillsflat
repo<your-agent-skills-repo>/skillsnested (category/name)

All paths are overridable with environment variables (SM_PI_SKILLS, SM_OPENCODE_SKILLS, SM_CLAUDE_SKILLS, SM_SHARED_SKILLS, SM_REPO_SKILLS, SM_PORT) - so the app works on any machine layout.

06Portability and Explain

Portability reports what Pi, Claude, Codex, and OpenCode do with a skill's frontmatter. It separates documented facts from inferred behavior, flags behavioral fields that may be ignored, and surfaces unknown custom fields without pretending they are errors.

Portability - which claude invocation fields silently do not carry over to pi/codex/opencode.

Explain answers why a specific agent sees a skill, or why it does not. Each verdict traces discovery to resolved paths, reports precedence and integrity against the repo source, and labels the evidence level.

Explain - per-agent verdicts with the honest negative case stated.

07The skill workspace

Selecting a skill opens an origin-led evidence workspace instead of a drawer. It shows the canonical origin, the agent variant matrix, fleet evidence, portability, explain, and safe operations in one place. Public GitHub facts are served from a local cache and refresh only when you choose Refresh GitHub facts - opening a skill never polls GitHub.

The skill workspace - canonical origin evidence, variants, portability, explain, and safe operations.

Agent variant matrix: every skill shows Pi, Claude, OpenCode, and Codex in a fixed order with an honest Canonical, Variant stored, Deployed, Verified, or Unknown state. Absent sidecars and missing snapshots stay Unknown - never a failure or an invented adaptation.

The agent variant matrix - per-agent state with evidence level, never a guessed adaptation.

Adaptation reviews: an upstream revision can generate an AI-assisted Adaptation Review that identifies behavior changes and proposes each affected variant with evidence and uncertainty made visible. Unknown or unsupported mappings block apply rather than inventing an adaptation. Approved reviews apply as a single verified, commit-and-push revision with rollback on failure.

08Provenance, updates, and variants

Provenance tracks where every skill came from. A committed skillmgr.yaml records upstream sources with pinned revisions, so third-party skills can be updated from their originals - not just from your repo. Frontmatter extraction is only a suggested import; the manifest is the authority.

Upstream updates preview a full-directory diff at a pinned revision, gate on security changes (typed acknowledgement when executables appear), and apply with rollback. No HEAD-guessing, no silent overwrites.

Variants adapt a claude-only skill for another agent: invocation fields are dropped, guidance folded into the description, and opencode-style triggers added where relevant. Variants are full snapshots, deployed explicitly, and verified before they stay - linked to the skill, never counted as drift or duplicates.

09API

EndpointReturns
GET /the dashboard
GET /api/inventoryfull inventory (cached 60s)
GET /api/skill?name=Xcopies + description + full SKILL.md
GET /api/compatfleet frontmatter compatibility report
GET /api/explain?name=Xper-agent discovery verdict and compatibility for one skill
GET /api/variant-matrix?name=Xper-agent variant state for one skill
GET /api/refreshforce re-scan, returns inventory

10Troubleshooting

Port already in use? - set SM_PORT to another port.
Skills not showing? - check the scan paths exist (the defaults are in the table above). Override with the env vars if your layout differs.
Nothing marked DRIFT? - good. That is the healthy state.
Dashboard stuck on "scanning..."? - the first scan can take a few seconds on large setups; hit Re-scan if it never lands.
